title: sdk-pioneer-lab-daily-log-apr-14-2026
content:
Playtest / Pioneer Lab — daily log (14 Apr 2026)

Attendees: Aisha Patel (owner), Ethan Liu, Marcos Rivera, Hannah Kim, Priya Desai (observer)
Duration: 45m
Location: #devexp-playtest / Zoom

Goal: rapid iteration on three experimental quickstarts + validate Node SDK memory profile under burst workloads. Capture immediate action items and decisions for runbook updates.

Agenda:
- Quickstart 1 (python-simple-chat) UX friction points
- Samples generator tool (samples-mint) stabilization status
- Node SDK leak repro and mitigation plan
- Telemetry naming and minimal events for cost/latency tracking
- Open parking-lot items / next 48h plan

NOTES:
1) Quickstart UX: python-simple-chat
- Testers (5 internal devs) reported two major pinch points: long install step (heavy deps) and confusing auth instructions for env var vs local config.
- Decision: replace heavy optional dependencies with a lightweight example that uses the hosted API only (no local model runtime). Keep an addon section showing local mode.
- UX change to docs: move auth example above the first code sample and add a one-liner "try with free credits" CTA. Marcos to draft new intro paragraph and ETA: 2026-04-16.

2) samples-mint (generator)
- Recent merge introduced intermittent filename collisions when multiple devs generate sample sets simultaneously. Root cause: generator used timestamp at second precision when naming buckets.
- Short-term: bump to millisecond timestamp + random suffix (Marcos PR #482). Long-term: add optimistic-locking on sample manifest writes.
- Action: Ethan will cut the hotfix branch and deploy to playground by EOD 2026-04-15. Test matrix includes parallel runs (5x) and CI smoke for manifest integrity.

3) Node SDK memory leak investigation
- Repro: synthetic burst test (100 concurrent streams, avg session length 12s) reproducibly shows ~120MB growth per minute in dev workstation runs. Heap snapshots point to per-stream timer references and a pending-requests map never cleared on early cancel.
- Hypothesis: on-client cancellation path misses cleanup when stream closes with non-200 status.
- Quick mitigation: introduce a per-stream finalizer and add stronger invariants in the client close() path. Priya confirmed a small change reduces leak in local test to ~5MB/min.
- Owner: Ethan. Target: PR with tests by 2026-04-16, follow-up load test in staging on 2026-04-17 (Marcos to schedule).

4) Telemetry minimal schema for quickstarts
- Need: quickstarts should emit minimal telemetry events so we can measure "first successful request" and average time-to-first-byte without leaking PII.
- Proposed events: quickstart.started, quickstart.first_success, quickstart.error (error_code), quickstart.sample_generated. Include minimal labels: sample_id (opaque id), runtime_mode (hosted|local). No user tokens or prompt content.
- Decision: accept proposed schema. Hannah to add to telemetry spec and update the metric dashboard board (PR to infra-telemetry) by 2026-04-18.

5) Docs & runbooks
- Need a short runbook entry for Node SDK memory incidents (how to collect heap snapshots, how to use the repro harness). Aisha will author initial runbook and link sample heap snapshots.
- Quickstarts checklist: install, auth, hello-world success, cleanup. Add an explicit "how to switch to hosted API" step to lower friction.

Blockers / Risks:
- Samples generator race condition could block multiple teams if not hotfixed quickly. Mitigation: deploy hotfix + postmortem if failure seen.
- Staging capacity: full concurrency test requires a staging cluster resize; infra approval pending (Infra ticket JIRA-OPS-3348 in review).

Action items (owner / due):
- Ethan: hotfix PR for samples-mint + deploy to playground (2026-04-15)
- Marcos: draft new quickstart intro + update README (2026-04-16)
- Ethan: Node SDK cleanup PR + unit tests (2026-04-16)
- Marcos: schedule staging load run for Node SDK leak test (2026-04-17)
- Hannah: telemetry schema update + dashboard PR (2026-04-18)
- Aisha: runbook stub for memory incidents + attach heap snapshots (2026-04-16)

Parking lot / follow-ups:
- Evaluate LTO + binary stripping for Go SDK (Priya volunteered to prototype next week).
- Consider offering a single-file quickstart artifact (zip with minimal deps) for offline demos.
- Postmortem template for generator race incidents (if deployed hotfix still fails).

Notes to self (Aisha):
- Keep quickstart on-ramp <5 minutes from zero to first request. If install + auth time >3min, iterate again with lighter deps.
- Document the exact reproducible script for Node burst test and add to test-harness repo.

End log. Next check-in: quick async update channel by 2026-04-15 10:00 PT; next in-person sync if blocker unresolved.
